title: Strategic modular assembly of trifluoromethylated energetic materials via triazine-based scaffolds

Modular triazine-based SNAr assembly of a CF₃-fused precursor afforded nitrogen-rich energetic frameworks. Perchlorate salt 4 showed improved density and detonation performance together with very low sensitivity.
